title: Chart quiz #6
caption:
Chart quiz #6. Think you can read the next move?

Q1: Continue, or reverse?
Q2: What does the volume say?
Q3: Where does the stop go?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #BullFlag #Volume #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Flags, volume and stops. Question one. A sharp rally, then a quiet drift lower on light volume. Does the move continue, or reverse? It continued. That's a bull flag. A strong pole, then a calm pause on fading volume, before the next leg up. Question two. Price broke above resistance. Look at the volume bars. Does the volume confirm the move, or warn against it? It confirms it. Volume more than doubled on the breakout candles. Lots of traders joined the move, and it kept going. Question three. You just bought this bounce off support. Where does the stop go? A, B, or C? A, just below the swing low. C gets hit by an ordinary dip, and B risks far too much. Below the swing low is where your idea is proven wrong. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
